## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Describe the Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this fits the playful, authentic, and spontaneous personality of Nexus.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Feature Area

Which area of the application does this feature request apply to?

- [ ] Orbit Screen (Spontaneous Discovery)
- [ ] Chat & Messaging
- [ ] Spotify Integration (Music Taste Signals)
- [ ] Safety Center / Meetup-Safety Guidance
- [ ] Campus-Gating (`mec` flavor specific features)
- [ ] Developer Experience / Devops / Docker Setup
- [ ] Other (please specify: _____)

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockup designs, or screenshots about the feature request here.
